task: OpenClaw CEO verification evidence contract and truthful Coupang price reporting
problem: OpenClaw opened Coupang, skipped GUI inspection, called web_search, and stated prices that were absent from the recorded tool result as current visible prices.

implementation.summary: Added broad-but-imperative CEO verification tracking, question-relevant evidence-tool validation, fail-closed outbound evidence replacement, Coupang price intent routing, deterministic same-card OCR price replies, structured screenshot media attachment, session+run scoping, OCR sanitization, and delivery/expiry Trash cleanup.
Documented mandatory CEO verification evidence, GUI screenshot preference, non-GUI artifact hierarchy, unsupported-claim suppression, and ephemeral capture disposal.

Added regression coverage for the exact incident phrase, web_search blocking, deterministic multi-card price output, unsafe error and OCR sanitization, generated capture allowlisting, irrelevant evidence tools, fail-closed payload replacement, and verified evidence footers.
Recorded incident, root causes, enforced architecture, cleanup lifecycle, and production acceptance criteria.

verification.target: session/run pending evidence and final-content delivery cleanup diff
verification.result: red_team_clear after Gemini blocks for session-only cross-turn leakage; final design uses exact session+run when present, an unambiguous single-pending-state session fallback when durable delivery omits runId, and session+SHA-256(final text) message_sent cleanup.

verification.result: CONFIRMED screen inspection and exact OCR answer delivery, but attachments=[] exposed that durable reply_payload_sending omitted runId; this directly motivated the single-state fail-closed fallback.

verification.result: PASS: Discord evidence message 1532685157096624328 contained one 1920x2040 PNG attachment; tool reported attempted=true, ok=true, attachmentCount=1, trashedCaptureCount=3; all three generated source captures were absent and three corresponding OpenClaw-Peekaboo Trash entries were present. Final text answer followed in message 1532685194627252266.

verification.name: production incident trajectory diagnosis
verification.result: CONFIRMED user-facing defect: harness_browser_open opened only https://www.coupang.com/; web_search returned only a completed query record with no product-price evidence; no screen inspection ran in the price turn; assistant nevertheless stated 52,200원, 52,780원, and 59,850원. The later evidence request returned screen_inspect_not_bound_to_routed_owner_request.

governance_bootstrap.summary: Confirmed requirement-to-evidence completion mapping and real user-entrypoint verification.
Confirmed origin/main deployment SoT, Mac mini real-runtime verification, and completion guard requirements.

residual_risks.risk: A screenshot can contain sensitive content already visible in the CEO's own browser window.
residual_risks.mitigation: Evidence delivery is restricted to authenticated owner-only Discord sessions, uses only generated allowlisted captures, and immediately moves every local capture to Trash after a fully confirmed delivery receipt.
